canonical_title: Pressure venting and drainage of rotor blades

versions.title_at_revision: Pressure venting and drainage of rotor blades
versions.text: (a) For each rotor blade: (1) There must be means for venting the internal pressure of the blade; (2) Drainage holes must be provided for the blade; and (3) The blade must be designed to prevent water from becoming trapped in it. (b) Sub-paragraphs (a)(1) and (2) do not apply to sealed rotor blades capable of withstanding the maximum pressure differentials expected in service.
